$comment: Light backlog math for the marketing tool output. Rough, honest placeholder ranges. Tuneable by non-devs. Numbers hedged, never presented as a promise. If a prospect wants the real math, that's the deep diagnostic.

industry_incident_factor.$comment: Multiplier on the base pending-findings rate. Regulated + legacy-heavy industries carry higher backlogs per endpoint. Rough directional estimates.

backlog_per_endpoint_baseline.$comment: Rough baseline: pending findings per managed endpoint. Industry benchmarks vary widely; this is a mid-range placeholder for a plausible number.

remedio_clear_rate.$comment: Fraction of the current backlog Remedio would typically clear in the first quarter of operation.

time_to_fix_reduction.$comment: Median improvement in time-to-fix once Remedio is in the flow.
